method_card.title: Free-Time Activities and Hobbies
method_card.content:
This lesson covers key vocabulary for hobbies, sports and leisure activities, plus the present tense and opinion phrases with gustar-type verbs.

SpanishEnglish
el tiempo librefree time
jugar al futbolto play football
nadarto swim
escuchar musicato listen to music
ver la televisionto watch TV
salir con amigosto go out with friends
ir al cineto go to the cinema
montar en bicicletato ride a bike
leerto read
cocinarto cook
me gustaI like
me encantaI love
prefieroI prefer
siemprealways
a vecessometimes

Grammar focus: The present tense has three verb groups: -ar (jugar: juego, juegas, juega, jugamos, jugais, juegan), -er (comer: como, comes, come, comemos, comeis, comen), and -ir (vivir: vivo, vives, vive, vivimos, vivis, viven). Use me gusta + infinitive to say what you like doing.

Model: En mi tiempo libre, me encanta jugar al futbol con mis amigos. Normalmente jugamos los sabados por la manana. (In my free time, I love playing football with my friends. We normally play on Saturday mornings.)
steps: Learn the key vocabulary for free-time activities and hobbies
Master the present tense endings for -ar, -er and -ir verbs
Practise using me gusta, me encanta and prefiero with infinitives
Add frequency adverbs like siempre, a veces and normalmente to your sentences

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'Me encanta jugar al futbol con mis amigos los sabados.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Break the sentence into chunks: 'Me encanta' = I love, 'jugar al futbol' = playing football, 'con mis amigos' = with my friends, 'los sabados' = on Saturdays.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Join them together in natural English word order.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I love playing football with my friends on Saturdays.

worked_examples.question: Fill in the gap: 'Normalmente _____ al tenis despues del instituto.' (yo, jugar)

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Identify the subject: 'yo' (I). The verb is 'jugar' — an -ar verb with a stem change (u → ue).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Present tense yo form of jugar: juego (the u changes to ue in all forms except nosotros/vosotros).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: juego — 'Normalmente juego al tenis despues del instituto.'

worked_examples.question: Translate to Spanish: 'I usually go to the cinema with my friends, but sometimes I prefer to read at home.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: 'I usually go' = 'Normalmente voy' (ir is irregular: yo voy). 'to the cinema' = 'al cine'. 'with my friends' = 'con mis amigos'.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: 'but sometimes' = 'pero a veces'. 'I prefer to read' = 'prefiero leer' (preferir is a stem-changing verb: e → ie). 'at home' = 'en casa'.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Normalmente voy al cine con mis amigos, pero a veces prefiero leer en casa.

method_card.title: Music, Film and Television
method_card.content:
This lesson covers vocabulary for music genres, film types and TV programmes, plus adjective agreement and a range of opinion phrases beyond me gusta.

SpanishEnglish
la musica poppop music
el rockrock
el reguetonreggaeton
una pelicula de accionaction film
una pelicula de terrorhorror film
una comediacomedy
una seriea series
las noticiasthe news
divertido/afun/funny
aburrido/aboring
emocionanteexciting
me encantaI love it
no soportoI can't stand
me aburreit bores me

Grammar focus: Adjectives must agree in gender and number with the noun they describe: una pelicula divertida (feminine), un programa divertido (masculine). Adjectives ending in -e or a consonant don't change: emocionante, genial.

Model: Mi pelicula favorita es una comedia porque es muy divertida. No soporto las peliculas de terror porque me dan miedo. (My favourite film is a comedy because it's very funny. I can't stand horror films because they scare me.)
steps: Learn the vocabulary for music genres, film types and TV programmes
Master adjective agreement rules for describing entertainment
Practise using a range of opinion phrases beyond me gusta
Build extended sentences with porque and connectives

method_card.title: Sport and Exercise
method_card.content:
This lesson covers sport and exercise vocabulary, the verbs jugar a, hacer and practicar, and using multiple tenses to describe exercise habits.

SpanishEnglish
el futbolfootball
el baloncestobasketball
la natacionswimming
el ciclismocycling
correrto run
ir al gimnasioto go to the gym
hacer ejercicioto exercise
jugar al tenisto play tennis
mantenerse en formato keep fit
es bueno para la saludit's good for health
dos veces a la semanatwice a week
todos los diasevery day
los fines de semanaat weekends

Grammar focus: Use jugar a for team/ball sports (juego al futbol) and hacer for individual activities (hago natacion). Jugar is stem-changing (u→ue): juego, juegas, juega, jugamos, jugais, juegan. Hacer is irregular in yo: hago.

Model: Juego al futbol dos veces a la semana porque es divertido y me mantiene en forma. Ayer jugue al tenis con mi hermano. (I play football twice a week because it's fun and it keeps me fit. Yesterday I played tennis with my brother.)
steps: Learn the sport and exercise vocabulary with correct verb pairings
Master jugar a for team sports and hacer for individual activities
Practise describing exercise habits using frequency phrases
Use three tenses to talk about sport: present, preterite, and near future

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — sport and health across all papers

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'Hago natacion tres veces a la semana porque me mantiene en forma.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: 'Hago natacion' = I do swimming (hacer + activity). 'tres veces a la semana' = three times a week. 'porque' = because. 'me mantiene en forma' = it keeps me fit.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Join into natural English.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I go swimming three times a week because it keeps me fit.

worked_examples.question: Which verb do you use: 'Yo _____ al baloncesto' — jugar or hacer?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Basketball is a team/ball sport, so use jugar a.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Jugar is stem-changing (u→ue) in the yo form: juego. With al (a + el): juego al baloncesto.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Juego al baloncesto — use jugar a for team/ball sports.

Grammar focus: Use polite forms: quisiera (I would like — imperfect subjunctive of querer) or me gustaria (conditional). Use usted form with waiters: ¿Tiene...?, ¿Puede traer...?.

method_card.title: Spanish Festivals and Celebrations
method_card.content:
This lesson covers four major festivals: Las Fallas, La Tomatina, Semana Santa and El Dia de los Muertos, plus the conditional tense and festival sentence builders.

SpanishEnglish
la fiestathe festival
las fallasthe Fallas sculptures
los fuegos artificialesfireworks
un desfilea parade
tirar tomatesto throw tomatoes
divertirseto enjoy oneself
una procesiona procession
el Dia de los MuertosDay of the Dead
una ofrendaan altar/offering
me gustaria ir aI would like to go to
seria inolvidableit would be unforgettable
la fiesta tiene lugar enthe festival takes place in
durante la fiesta se puededuring the festival you can

Grammar focus: The conditional tense (seria, me gustaria, iria, encontraria) is used to say what you would do. Form it with the infinitive + endings: -ia, -ias, -ia, -iamos, -iais, -ian. Use it alongside present and preterite for a three-tense answer.

Model: Siempre he querido ir a La Tomatina ya que seria inolvidable. Durante la fiesta se puede tirar tomates y divertirse. (I have always wanted to go to La Tomatina since it would be unforgettable. During the festival you can throw tomatoes and enjoy yourself.)
steps: Learn the key facts about Las Fallas, La Tomatina, Semana Santa and El Dia de los Muertos
Master festival sentence builders: la fiesta tiene lugar en, durante la fiesta se puede
Practise using the conditional tense for hypothetical situations
Combine three tenses in your answers about festivals

worked_examples.question: How do you use the conditional to talk about festivals?

steps.label: Step 1

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Use with opinion phrases: 'Me gustaria ir a...' (I would like to go to...), 'Seria inolvidable' (It would be unforgettable).

steps.label: Answer

This lesson covers daily life differences between Spain and the UK, family customs, Latin American traditions, and comparison structures.

SpanishEnglish

Grammar focus: Comparison structures: En Espana se come mas tarde que en Inglaterra (In Spain they eat later than in England). Use a diferencia de (unlike), mientras que (while/whereas), and sin embargo (however) for comparing cultures.

Model: En Espana la comida principal es el almuerzo, mientras que en Inglaterra es la cena. A diferencia de los britanicos, los espanoles suelen saludar con dos besos. (In Spain the main meal is lunch, whereas in England it is dinner. Unlike the British, Spaniards usually greet with two kisses.)
steps: Learn the key differences in daily life between Spain and the UK
Master comparison structures: a diferencia de, mientras que, sin embargo
Know specific customs like la siesta, el paseo, la sobremesa and la quinceanera
Practise writing structured comparisons using contrast connectives

method_card.content:
This lesson covers physical descriptions, personality adjectives, how to argue whether someone is a good or bad role model, and the imperfect tense for describing the past.

SpanishEnglish
un modelo a seguira role model
alto/atall
delgado/aslim
el pelo largolong hair
generoso/agenerous
humildehumble
trabajador/ahardworking
egoistaselfish
arrogantearrogant
tiene buenos valoreshas good values
dona dinero a buenas causasdonates money to good causes

era / tenia / haciaused to be / used to have / used to do

Grammar focus: The imperfect tense describes what someone used to be like or used to do: era (was/used to be), tenia (had/used to have), hacia (did/used to do), iba (went/used to go). Use alongside present and preterite for three tenses.

Model: Pienso que Rosalia es un buen modelo a seguir dado que es una cantante con mucho talento. Cuando era joven, estudiaba musica en Barcelona. (I think Rosalia is a good role model given that she is a very talented singer. When she was young, she studied music in Barcelona.)

Master arguments for and against celebrity role models
Practise using the imperfect tense for describing the past
Build extended answers using three tenses and connectives like dado que, ya que
